evaluation_contract.cost_treatment: 25 bps per side applied to the long-short spread
evaluation_contract.event_time_unit: monthly revision cohort (issuer observation per cohort)
evaluation_contract.execution_lag: first full trading session STRICTLY AFTER the revision is available (>=1 session lag; never the availability-day close)
evaluation_contract.holdout_rule: final 30% of cohorts, sign-confirm only, once-usable
evaluation_contract.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR over EXACTLY the six pre-registered hypotheses (family_size=6)
evaluation_contract.neutralization: market + sector (historically valid only; unavailable historical industry -> DATA_HOLD, never current substitution)
evaluation_contract.observation_timestamp_rule: provider source_availability_timestamp; a signal may use ONLY information available at that stamp
evaluation_contract.selection_before_evidence: all six formulas + directions frozen BEFORE any real trial data is inspected

hypotheses.economic_rationale: Analysts under-react to their own information: a positive change in the consensus EPS estimate predicts positive drift (estimate-revision anomaly).
hypotheses.execution_lag: first full trading session STRICTLY AFTER the revision is available (>=1 session lag; never the availability-day close)
hypotheses.formula: d(consensus_mean_EPS) scaled by |prior_consensus| (or price), cross-sectional rank at the availability stamp
hypotheses.holdout_rule: final 30% of cohorts, sign-confirm only, once-usable
hypotheses.observation_timestamp_rule: provider source_availability_timestamp; a signal may use ONLY information available at that stamp

hypotheses.economic_rationale: Revenue estimate revisions carry information orthogonal to EPS (top-line vs margin); rising revenue consensus predicts positive drift.
hypotheses.execution_lag: first full trading session STRICTLY AFTER the revision is available (>=1 session lag; never the availability-day close)
hypotheses.formula: d(consensus_mean_REVENUE) scaled by prior_consensus, cross-sectional rank
hypotheses.holdout_rule: final 30% of cohorts, sign-confirm only, once-usable
hypotheses.observation_timestamp_rule: provider source_availability_timestamp; a signal may use ONLY information available at that stamp

hypotheses.economic_rationale: Revision BREADTH (how many analysts move up vs down) is a cleaner, less noisy signal than the magnitude of any single revision.
hypotheses.execution_lag: first full trading session STRICTLY AFTER the revision is available (>=1 session lag; never the availability-day close)
hypotheses.holdout_rule: final 30% of cohorts, sign-confirm only, once-usable
hypotheses.observation_timestamp_rule: provider source_availability_timestamp; a signal may use ONLY information available at that stamp

hypotheses.economic_rationale: EPS and revenue revisions AGREEING (both up or both down) is a higher-conviction signal than either leg alone (two independent legs confirming).
hypotheses.execution_lag: first full trading session STRICTLY AFTER the revision is available (>=1 session lag; never the availability-day close)
hypotheses.formula: sign-agreeing rank(d_EPS_consensus) + rank(d_REVENUE_consensus); gated on same sign
hypotheses.holdout_rule: final 30% of cohorts, sign-confirm only, once-usable
hypotheses.observation_timestamp_rule: provider source_availability_timestamp; a signal may use ONLY information available at that stamp

hypotheses.economic_rationale: The CHANGE in the revision trend (acceleration) leads the level: consensus that is revising up faster than last period predicts stronger drift.
hypotheses.execution_lag: first full trading session STRICTLY AFTER the revision is available (>=1 session lag; never the availability-day close)
hypotheses.formula: d2(consensus_mean_EPS) = this-period revision minus prior-period revision, rank
hypotheses.holdout_rule: final 30% of cohorts, sign-confirm only, once-usable
hypotheses.observation_timestamp_rule: provider source_availability_timestamp; a signal may use ONLY information available at that stamp

hypotheses.economic_rationale: RISING dispersion (disagreement) signals rising uncertainty and predicts LOWER future returns (disagreement/uncertainty anomaly).
hypotheses.execution_lag: first full trading session STRICTLY AFTER the revision is available (>=1 session lag; never the availability-day close)
hypotheses.holdout_rule: final 30% of cohorts, sign-confirm only, once-usable
hypotheses.observation_timestamp_rule: provider source_availability_timestamp; a signal may use ONLY information available at that stamp
